description: A laughing young woman in a long navy coat walks up to her front door on a terraced street on a rainy evening, holding a black umbrella over her head and carrying brown paper shopping bags. A big fluffy brown and white dog in a yellow raincoat walks beside her and looks up at her. She reaches the step, takes out her house keys and unlocks the warm, glowing yellow door while the dog waits next to her. Lit windows, street lamps and wet paving stones fill the street behind them.
